author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Dum spiro, spero — Theocritus (Idylls) & Cicero (Letters to Atticus)
explanation: As long as breath continues to flow in and out of the lungs, the final verdict of your life has not been sealed. No failure is final, no diagnosis has the ultimate word, and no mistake is beyond redemption. As long as you draw breath, the opportunity for courage and rebirth remains.
practicalInsight: Take three deep, full breaths right now. Feel the oxygen flooding your blood and recommit to hope.
reflectionPrompt: Where have you prematurely surrendered to despair, forgetting that breath in your lungs means your story is still being written?
